summary: Unconditional function-pointer table initializer for an alternative SSE math dispatch table. Fills the 33 used dword slots of the table at a1 with SSE math routines: vector sums and normalization, linear/cubic/hermite/bezier/bilinear spline interpolation, Newton-Raphson reciprocal and normalize refinement, 3x3 rotation-matrix multiply, rotation-matrix-to-axis-angle conversion, plus the sub_51FD20 and sub_51FEB0 helpers. No guards and no callees; returns the table pointer a1. Invoked by sub_50FEA7 during dispatch-table setup.
